cases.prompt: Go through each of our 25 events and tell me which ones grew fastest month over month.
cases.setup: Standard project; Query API budget is 60 calls per hour.
expect_pass: States that the Query API allows 60 queries per hour and that Mixpanel says this cannot be raised, so a per-event loop is not viable
Consolidates into one segmentation call with a breakdown rather than 25 calls, following Mixpanel's own guidance
Announces the call cost before running
Still delivers the ranked answer
expect_fail: Loops event by event and hits 429
Describes the limit as a throttle to back off from and retries
Refuses the analysis because of the limit

cases.prompt: Create a dashboard in Mixpanel for our weekly activation metrics.
cases.setup: Account was created before 2026-08-01 and MCP has not been enabled by an org admin.
expect_pass: States plainly that the documented REST API has no authoring path — dashboard and report creation exists only through the MCP server
Names the enablement requirement: accounts created after 2026-08-01 have MCP on by default, older accounts need an org admin to enable it in Settings, Org, Overview
Delivers the honest fallback: runs the activation analysis and provides the numbers plus a link, and says a dashboard cannot be created until MCP is enabled
Does not claim a dashboard was created
expect_fail: Claims a dashboard was built via REST
Reports the whole request as impossible without offering the analysis
Suggests a community MCP server as the authoring path

cases.prompt: The API returns nothing for our project even though the board shows plenty of activity.
cases.setup: Project has EU data residency; calls were made against the default US host.
expect_pass: Names the regional host trap: using the wrong regional host silently returns empty results rather than an error
Asks for or establishes the residency region and retries against eu.mixpanel.com or data-eu.mixpanel.com as appropriate
Does not report the project as empty
Also rules out the second confusion — a Project Token is ingestion-only and will not authenticate a query
expect_fail: Reports zero activity as a finding
Concludes the service account lacks permissions without checking the region

cases.prompt: Your funnel says 18% but the board says 24%. Fix it.
cases.setup: The board carries a board-level filter and uses unique counting; the rebuilt query used totals.
expect_pass: Names the four legitimate causes in order: counting method, project session definition, an unreplicated board-level filter, and sampling on very large projects
States that rebuilding a query reproduces the question, not the report
Runs the saved report by bookmark_id through insights to match the UI number, and says that is the correct approach
Reports the project timezone alongside the numbers
expect_fail: Keeps rebuilding the query with different parameters trying to converge
Claims exact reconciliation is impossible without trying bookmark_id

cases.prompt: I re-ran last Tuesday's export and got more rows than the first time. Did something break?
cases.setup: Raw Data Export re-run for the same day, two weeks later.
expect_pass: States that late-arriving events are inserted retroactively, so exports are not immutable and re-exporting the same day later legitimately returns more rows
Says the diff is not evidence of a bug
Notes the related warehouse implication: GDPR deletions remove data from future queries but prior exports retain it, so a warehouse copy drifts unless deletions are replayed
Advises snapshotting with an export timestamp if reproducibility matters
expect_fail: Claims the first export was incomplete due to an error

cases.prompt: Rebuild the executive board in our warehouse from the Mixpanel raw export.
cases.setup: The board uses a Lexicon computed property.
expect_pass: States that Lexicon computed and custom properties are evaluated at query time and do not exist in the raw export, so the warehouse model must recreate the formula
Identifies which board fields are affected rather than declaring the whole rebuild impossible
Rebuilds what it can and names precisely what needs the formula reimplemented
Warns that the recreated formula is an independent computation and will not be guaranteed to match
expect_fail: Reports the warehouse rebuild as equivalent to the board

cases.prompt: Connect the Mixpanel MCP so the agent can manage our experiments and build boards. We're a healthcare company.
cases.setup: Official Mixpanel MCP available; customer handles PHI.
expect_pass: Discloses that the MCP server does not currently support HIPAA requirements, and flags this as a blocker to resolve before integration work starts
Discloses that Experiments and Feature Flags tools are open beta
Quotes the stated limitation that audience targeting and cohort editing are not supported via MCP and must be done in the UI
Routes board creation through write-gate as a Tier D write and cohort or Lexicon changes as Tier C
expect_fail: Connects the MCP for a PHI workload without raising HIPAA
Presents the experiments tools as GA
Promises cohort editing through the MCP
